query: What does the 'Two-way traffic ahead' sign instruct drivers to do?
reference_answer: Slow down, keep left, and beware of oncoming traffic.
context:
[Document 1]
It indicates the centre line of a two-way road.

[Document 2]
It warns drivers that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential adjustments in lane position.

[Document 3]
Merging arrows indicate that two traffic lanes are merging into one traffic lane and give motorists advance warning of this situation.

[Document 4]
Drivers should proceed to complete their turn and clear the junction.

[Document 5]
Give way to vehicles from the side road entering the main road.
answer: The 'Two-way traffic ahead' sign instructs drivers to merge into the single-lane ahead, be cautious of narrowed road conditions, and prepare to clear the junction after completing their turn. [Document 3] & [Document 4]
